breadcrumbs.home: Breadcrumb label for the homepage. Shown in the navigation path at the top of every page.
breadcrumbs.about: Breadcrumb label for the about page.
breadcrumbs.audits: Breadcrumb label for the audits section.
breadcrumbs.ecos_v1: Breadcrumb label for the ECOS audit result pages. Short technical label.
breadcrumbs.blog: Breadcrumb label for the blog section.

sec_general.trigger_label: Navigation menu trigger label. Opens the main project navigation dropdown. Single word.

home.title: Navigation card title for the homepage link in the dropdown menu.
home.description: Navigation card tagline for the homepage. Shows the four ECOS values. Keep as-is — this is the official ECOS tagline.

about.title: Navigation card title for the about page link in the dropdown menu.
about.description: Navigation card tagline for the about page. Short, catchy phrase describing the project mission. One sentence.

docs.title: Navigation card title for the documentation page link in the dropdown menu.
docs.description: Navigation card description for the docs page. Lists the main topics covered: methodology, API, technical implementation. Keep concise.

audits.title: Navigation card title for the audits section link in the dropdown menu.
audits.description: Navigation card description for the audits section. Summarizes what the section offers. Keep concise.

blog.title: Navigation card title for the blog link in the dropdown menu.
blog.description: Navigation card description for the blog. Lists the main topics. Keep concise.

sec_settings.trigger_label: Navigation menu trigger label. Opens the settings panel. Single word.
sec_settings.sec_title: Settings panel heading. Shown at the top of the settings dropdown panel.
sec_settings.language: Settings section label. Labels the language selector. Single word.

theme.title: Settings section label. Labels the appearance/theme selector.
theme.b_system: Toggle button label. Sets the color theme to follow the system preference.
theme.b_light: Toggle button label. Sets the color theme to light mode.
theme.b_dark: Toggle button label. Sets the color theme to dark mode.

font_size.title: Settings section label. Labels the font size controls.
font_size.b_reset: Button label. Resets the font size to the default value. Single word.

grayscale.title: Settings section label. Labels the color/grayscale toggle.
grayscale.b_colors: Toggle button label. Sets the display to normal colors.
grayscale.b_gray: Toggle button label. Sets the display to grayscale mode.

contrast.title: Settings section label. Labels the contrast toggle.
contrast.regular: Toggle button label. Sets contrast to normal.
contrast.high_contrast: Toggle button label. Sets contrast to high contrast mode.

logo.title: Title attribute for the site logo. Shown on hover.
logo.aria_label: ARIA label for the site logo. Read aloud by screen readers.

footer.contact_link_label: Footer link label. Links to the contact and legal notice page. In German contexts this covers the legally required 'Impressum'.
footer.privacy_link_label: Footer link label. Links to the privacy policy page.

alternative_language.title: Banner heading. Shown when content is available in the user's preferred language but they are viewing a different language version.
alternative_language.dont_show_message_again: Button or checkbox label inside the language suggestion banner. Dismisses the banner permanently.

cookie_consent.title: Cookie consent banner heading. Single word.
cookie_consent.msg_1: Cookie consent banner body text. Explains what cookies are used for and links to the privacy policy. Contains an HTML link — preserve it. Update the href for each language version (/privacy for English, /de/privacy for German).
cookie_consent.link_label: Cookie consent confirmation button. Dismisses the banner. Keep short and informal.

translated_content.and: Conjunction used to join two model names in the translation notice. Single word.
translated_content.translated_about_title: Section heading for the translation notice block shown on translated pages.
translated_content.translation_txt_ai: Translation notice text for AI-assisted translations. Shown as a disclosure on translated pages. Contains placeholders for model name(s), source language, and target language. No trailing period — may be combined with additional clauses.
translated_content.translation_txt: Translation notice text for non-AI translations. Contains placeholders for source and target language.
translated_content.translation_txt_ai_reviewed: Translation notice text for AI-assisted translations that were also reviewed by a human editor. Most detailed variant. Contains placeholders for model name(s), source language, and target language. Ends with a period.

source_langs.de: Inflected form of 'German' used as source language in the translation notice sentence. In German this requires the dative case ('aus dem Deutschen'). In English no inflection is needed.
source_langs.en: Inflected form of 'English' used as source language in the translation notice sentence.

target_langs.de: Inflected form of 'German' used as target language in the translation notice sentence. In German this requires the accusative case ('ins Deutsche'). In English no inflection is needed.
target_langs.en: Inflected form of 'English' used as target language in the translation notice sentence.
